literal: Carp painted eyes I as beg if sleep to the united one survival truth I will proclaim indeed.
translation: If my carp-like painted eyes would only sleep as I beg them to, I would proclaim the truth of my survival to my lover who united with me.
modern: நான் இரந்து கேட்டும் உறங்காத என் கயல் போன்ற மை தீட்டிய கண்கள் உறங்கினால், என்னோடு கலந்த காதலருக்கு நான் இன்னும் உயிரோடு இருக்கும் உண்மையைச் சொல்வேன்.
explanation: The speaker addresses her own sleepless eyes, which resemble carp fish painted with collyrium. She begs them to close and sleep so that she might see her lover in a dream. If her eyes would only grant her sleep, she could meet the lover who once united with her and proclaim the truth that she is still surviving despite the agony of separation. The particle 'மன்' adds a tone of longing and slight despair, as her eyes refuse to sleep, denying her even a dream of him.
